title: AITBASE VISION plugin manifest (plugin.json), draft
description: aitbase-plugin check enforces these rules and more (source id match, file names, screens). Keep both in sync.

id.description: Stable plugin id: two or more dot-separated lowercase parts. aitbase.* is reserved for official plugins. Must match AITBASE_PLUGIN_ID(...) in the source.

name.description: Display name. The device's assistant opens the plugin by this name, so keep it short and easy to say.

api_version.description: Plugin API version the plugin is written against.

entry.description: Build target name of the plugin program.

screens.description: Screens in ui/screens/<name>.xml, opened with aitbase_ui_open(p, "<name>", ...).

idle_face.description: One of ui.screens, offered as the device's home screen face (since SDK 0.10). The owner chooses it on the Device Console; the device shows it display only (no buttons or actions, at most 24 widgets and 8 KiB compiled) under its own badge. Its labels bind to face.1 to face.16, set with aitbase_face_set (needs idle.face).

sounds.description: Sounds in sounds/<name>.wav (16 kHz, mono, 16-bit PCM, at most 10 s), played with aitbase_audio_play(p, "<name>", ...). Needs audio.output.

triggers.description: Starts the plugin without the user opening it. One kind: a schedule, every every_min minutes (15 to 1440) while the device is idle. aitbase_trigger() returns "schedule" for such a run.

requested_capabilities.description: Capabilities the plugin uses. See docs/capabilities.md. During the preview the device grants every capability a plugin requests.
